## Predicting whether a promise will be kept

- 1135 resolved promises, 41% fully kept
- Leave-one-company-out AUC **0.646** (90% CI [0.618, 0.674]); company Say-Do score alone 0.5523; Brier 0.223 vs base rate 0.244
- Walk-forward (train on outcomes public before 2025-07-22, n=209; test on later promises, n=575): AUC **0.621** (90% CI [0.586, 0.658]); score-only 0.5625; Brier 0.235 vs 0.248

Top coefficients (positive = more likely kept):

- `cat_high_base` +1.13
- `margin_gap` -0.89
- `horizon_yrs` +0.85
- `ops_spread` +0.64
- `cat_low_base` -0.46
- `has_conditions` -0.45
- `sec_prepared` +0.43
- `muse_forecast_logit` +0.40
- `verifiable_fin` +0.40
- `role_leader` +0.35

## Market test (point-in-time, excess vs equal-weight universe)

- 145 call-events, 34 companies: top-tercile Say-Do +2.63% vs bottom -1.55% over 90 days; spread +4.18% (90% CI [-4.69, 13.02]); mean quarterly rank IC -0.03
- Event study (60d): kept revealed +1.26% (n=154), broken revealed +1.31% (n=167), diff -0.05% (90% CI [-3.13, 2.98])

Intervals that include zero mean the test is inconclusive at this sample size.
